observations: The indexed update retains sixteen accumulator vectors in registers; no direct rsp-relative vector spill/load appears in the bounded function.
The 56-byte local stack frame and eight general-purpose pushes preserve list lengths/bases and loop metadata. Rbp addresses in vector loads are weight-row bases, not stack spills.
Four signed-byte row loops each contain sixteen widening loads plus sixteen adds or subtracts per row and tile. Outer control visits two 512-lane tiles for L1=1024.
This inspection provides no cache-miss, throughput or stall measurements. Reducing a supposed vector-spill bottleneck is unsupported by this binary.
